Breakpoints.Advisor: Allocation Tab - Spaghetti/Counterfeit % to 0; Adventure Tab - Turn on Combat (Target: High Security Base, Idle Mode, Allow Fallthrough -> Select ITOPOD after unlocking boss 30); Gold Tab - Turn on CBlock Mode
Breakpoints.Block: Micro-CBlock (guide Chapter 2, T1-Mega). Contents: 5 Basic Challenges and 1 24H Challenge. Entry: after obtaining some AVSP gear, defeating Boss 100, and starting T4's unlock puzzle. Hands back to an LRB towards Mega/T4. Skip this profile if all 5 Basic Challenges are already done - the guide says to skip Micro in that case and the entries here would simply sit idle. Run the T4 unlock puzzle alongside the block: 'During your challenges, you can also be progressing the T4 unlock puzzle'.
Breakpoints.Comment: Guide focus for this block: 'features that push bosses and increase your Number, like Wandoos, Augmentations, Time Machine, and Blood Number'. Blood Number is not a profile field - it is the advisor's blood router, so leave Number as the default blood sink and keep the Blood Number threshold at 0. Beards are absent on purpose: the Beardverse comes after the Mini-CBlock, so there is nothing to allocate in Chapter 2. Advanced Training is absent because a 15 minute rebirth never runs long enough for AT to pay off. BESTAUG is used so no augment index has to be assumed this early; if idle energy gets reserved for an augment it cannot afford, swap BESTAUG for AUG-X and set a target level on the Augments tab (a capped target frees the energy again).
Breakpoints.RebirthNotes: Two entries, whichever fires first wins, and entering the next challenge pre-empts both. The 15 minute Time entry IS the guide's cadence, verbatim: 'It's suggested to do 15 minute rebirths to optimize number gain'. The Number 100 entry is NOT from the guide - it is the profile author's own convention, copied from the four C-Miniblock2.x profiles, and it only lets a rebirth fire EARLY once next-rebirth number gain is already past 100x. Raise it or delete it freely; the 15 minute ceiling is the part the guide actually asks for.
Breakpoints.GearNotes: Max P/T. Same shape as C-Miniblock2.1-100lc with the five body pieces moved back one zone: 122-126 is the A Very Strange Place set (the 'AVSP gear' named in the entry requirement) rather than the Mega set 130-134, which only drops in Mega Lands at the very end of the chapter. Accessories 440/117/108 are unchanged from 2.1 and all clear their boss requirement by Boss 100.
Breakpoints.ChallengeNotes: Basics first, then the 24H. The order is forced, not a preference: the 24 Hour Challenge does not unlock until a Basic Challenge has been completed within 24 hours. Finishing on a 24H to climb Number back up is also what the guide does at the end of the Mini-CBlock and CBlock1. This is the profile that seeds the Normal BASIC and 24HR lines - 24HR-1 here is what lets C-Miniblock2.4-Finish's 24HR-2 ever fire.
